functions.name: InitializeBnclientInterface
functions.comment:
Initializes the Battle.net client interface by loading Bnclient.dll.

  Algorithm:
    1. Validate pParams is not NULL (assert if NULL)
    2. Check if interface already initialized at offset 0x21d (541)
    3. If not initialized:
       a. Load "Bnclient.dll" via LoadLibraryA
       b. Get "QueryInterface" export via GetProcAddress
       c. Call QueryInterface to obtain interface pointer
       d. Store interface pointer in global and pParams+0x21d
       e. Call first vtable method to complete initialization

  Parameters:
    pParams (ECX) - Pointer to D2Multi params structure; offset 0x21d stores
                    the Bnclient interface pointer after initialization

  Returns:
    TRUE (1)  - Interface initialized successfully or already initialized
    FALSE (0) - Failed to load Bnclient.dll or QueryInterface export not found

  Special Cases:
    - Displays MessageBox with "D2Multi" title on failure (MB_ICONHAND = 0x10)
    - Calls FogAssert if pParams is NULL (line 0x47 = 71)
    - Caches module handle in g_hBnclientModule (0x6fa96c60)
    - Caches interface pointer in g_pBnclientInterface (0x6fa96c64)

functions.name: CancelScreenFade
functions.comment:
Cancels any active screen fade effect by clearing the fade timeout

Algorithm:
1. Clear global fade end time variable to zero
2. Return immediately to caller

Parameters:
None

Returns:
void - No return value

Special Cases:
Function can be called safely even when no fade is active
Immediate effect - any running ProcessScreenFadeOverlay will detect cancellation

Error Handling:
None required - simple memory store operation cannot fail

Magic Numbers Reference:
0x0 - Zero value indicating no active fade timeout
0x6fbe8f14 - Address of g_dwFadeEndTime global variable

functions.name: GetBnclientInterface
functions.comment:
Returns the global Bnclient.dll interface pointer.

  Algorithm:
    1. Load g_pBnclientInterface from global storage
    2. Return the interface pointer in EAX

  Parameters:
    None - this is a simple accessor function

  Returns:
    - void* - Pointer to IBnclientInterface if initialized
    - NULL (0) if Bnclient.dll not loaded or QueryInterface failed

  Notes:
    - Used as a tick callback for MessagePumpLoop
    - Interface is obtained via Bnclient.dll!QueryInterface() during InitializeBnclientInterface
    - The interface uses a COM-like vtable for method dispatch

functions.name: PollBnetLoginCredentialValidation
functions.comment:
Polling callback for MessagePumpLoop during Battle.net login credential validation.

Algorithm:
1. Call BnclientInterface vtable offset 0x64 (credential check operation)
2. If credential check returns non-zero, call StopMessageLoop to signal completion
3. Check if g_bBnetLoggedIn is non-zero; if so, skip to step 7
4. Call BnclientInterface vtable offset 0x74 (connection status check)
5. If connected, call FUN_6fa77540 to check login state
6. If login state check fails, exit early
7. Call BnclientInterface vtable offset 0x10 (process tick)
8. Call StopMessageLoop to end the loop
9. Return 1 (always continue message pump until StopMessageLoop called)

Parameters:
    pUnused - Unused context pointer passed from MessagePumpLoop (IMPLICIT: ECX points to stack)

Returns:
    1 - Always returns 1 to continue message pump polling

Caller Context:
    Called from FUN_6fa71430 via MessagePumpLoop(FUN_6fa71190) after initiating
    credential validation with BnclientInterface+0x60

BnclientInterface Virtual Table Offsets Used:
    +0x10: Process/tick operation
    +0x64: Credential validation check
    +0x74: Connection status check

Global References:
    g_pBnclientInterface (0x6fa96c64): Battle.net client COM interface pointer
    g_bBnetLoggedIn (0x6fa96c6c): Flag indicating logged-in state
    g_dwGameStateFlags (0x6fa96c68): Game state flags checked for abort condition

Note: Function body extends from 0x6fa71190 to 0x6fa711db (76 bytes) but Ghidra
analysis is incomplete. Raw disassembly shows RET 4 at end confirming __stdcall.

functions.name: PollBnetAccountOperationStatus
functions.comment:
Polling callback for MessagePumpLoop during Battle.net account/character operations.

  Algorithm:
    1. Call BnclientInterface vtable offset 0xAC (account operation status check)
    2. If status returns non-zero, call StopMessageLoop to signal completion
    3. Check if g_dwGameStateFlags is non-zero; if so, skip to step 7
    4. Call BnclientInterface vtable offset 0x74 (connection status check)
    5. If not connected (zero), return 1 to continue polling
    6. Call GetBnetLoginState to verify login; if zero (not logged in), return 1
    7. Call BnclientInterface vtable offset 0x10 (process tick)
    8. Call StopMessageLoop to end the loop
    9. Return 1 (always returns 1 to continue message pump)

  Parameters:
    pUnused  (ESP+4) - Unused context pointer passed from MessagePumpLoop

  Returns:
    1 - Always returns 1 to continue message pump polling

  Caller Context:
    Called from FUN_6fa71430 via MessagePumpLoop(PollBnetAccountOperationStatus) after
    initiating account operations with BnclientInterface+0xA8

  BnclientInterface Virtual Table Offsets Used:
    +0x10: Process/tick operation
    +0x74: Connection status check
    +0xAC: Account operation status check

  Global References:
    g_pBnclientInterface (0x6fa96c64): Battle.net client COM interface pointer
    g_dwGameStateFlags (0x6fa96c68): Game state flags checked for abort condition

  Note: Function spans 0x6fa711e0-0x6fa71227 (72 bytes). RET 4 confirms __stdcall.
  Similar in structure to PollBnetLoginCredentialValidation but polls 0xAC instead of 0x64.

functions.name: ConnectToBattleNet
functions.comment:
Initiates a connection to Battle.net servers.

Algorithm:
  1. Verify Bnclient interface is initialized (g_pBnclientInterface != NULL)
  2. Assert not already connecting (g_bConnectingToBnet == 0)
  3. Set connecting flag and reset connection attempt counter
  4. Reset connection status and output debug string
  5. Initialize Storm network layer (Ordinal_10001 = SNetInitialize)
  6. Call Bnclient->Connect (vtable offset 0x10)
  7. If connect call succeeds:
     a. Clear logged in flag (g_bBnetLoggedIn = 0)
     b. Initialize connection state and pump messages
     c. Check for user cancellation (g_dwGameStateFlags)
     d. Check connection status via Bnclient->GetStatus (vtable offset 0x4c)
     e. If status != 0x65 (101 = connected), prepare login and retry
     f. On success, call Bnclient->GetLoginInfo (vtable offset 0x28)
  8. Clean up connecting flag and return result

Parameters:
  None - uses global state (g_pBnclientInterface)

Returns:
  TRUE (1) - Connection established successfully
  FALSE (0) - Connection failed or interface not initialized

Special Cases:
  - Returns FALSE immediately if g_pBnclientInterface is NULL
  - Triggers FogAssert if already connecting (re-entrant call)
  - Status code 0x65 (101) indicates successful connection
  - User can cancel via g_dwGameStateFlags during message pump

Bnclient Interface Vtable Offsets:
  Offset | Method
  0x10   | Connect / Disconnect
  0x28   | GetLoginInfo
  0x48   | GetLoginResult
  0x4c   | GetConnectionStatus
  0x74   | IsLoggedIn

functions.name: PerformBnetLogin
functions.signature: int PerformBnetLogin(int nLoginContext, int nValidateCredentials, int nAccountOperation)
strings: 0x1F178|szWARNING:_Trying_to_log_in_when_a_6fa8f178|WARNING: Trying to log in when already logged in!.
functions.comment:
Performs Battle.net login sequence with optional credential validation and account operations.

Algorithm:
  1. Check BNClient interface availability via vtable offset 0x74
  2. If interface unavailable, display error string 0x14e3 and return failure
  3. If already logged in (g_bBnetLoggedIn != 0), log warning and return success
  4. Initialize login UI via FUN_6fa77550
  5. Get login status via vtable offset 0x28
  6. If nValidateCredentials is TRUE and credentials not yet validated:
     a. Call credential validation via vtable offset 0x60
     b. Poll via PollBnetLoginCredentialValidation until complete
     c. If failed (g_dwGameStateFlags != 0), cleanup and return failure
     d. Finalize validation via vtable offset 0x64
  7. If nAccountOperation is non-zero and validation succeeded:
     a. Process account operation based on nAccountOperation value
     b. Call HandleBnetConnectionError and return failure if error
  8. Check BNClient connection status via vtable offset 0x74
  9. If connected, perform actual login via vtable offset 0x8
  10. Poll login status via PollBnetLoginStatus until complete
  11. If successful, set g_bBnetLoggedIn = 1 and return TRUE
  12. Otherwise handle connection error and return FALSE

Parameters:
  nLoginContext (ECX)         - Login context structure address
  nValidateCredentials (EDX)  - TRUE (1) to validate credentials first
  nAccountOperation (Stack)   - Account operation type (0=none, 1=normal, 2-8=account ops)

Returns:
  1 (TRUE)  - Login successful, g_bBnetLoggedIn set to 1
  0 (FALSE) - Login failed

Special Cases:
  - Returns 1 immediately if already logged in (warning logged)
  - Returns 0 if BNClient interface is not available
  - Error codes 0xf-0x16 map to account operation failures

functions.name: HandleBnetConnectionError
functions.comment:
Displays error dialogs for Battle.net connection failures based on error code.

Algorithm:
  1. Allocate stack buffers for Unicode strings (3x 0x200 wchars = 0x1004 bytes)
  2. Initialize Unicode string buffers via default constructors
  3. Switch on error code (*pErrorInfo at offset 0) to select dialog strings:
     - Cases 1,3: Two-button dialog (OK/Cancel style)
     - Cases 2,4,5,7: One-button info dialog  
     - Case 6: Custom error with parameter string from pErrorInfo+4
     - Cases 8,default: Generic connection error
     - Cases 9-11 (0x9-0xB): CD Key errors with reconnect callback
     - Cases 12-14 (0xC-0xE): Account/version errors
     - Cases 15-22 (0xF-0x16): Realm/character errors with realm callback
  4. Load localized strings via ValidateStringId():
     - Title string ID stored in ESI (0x147C-0x1481)
     - Message string ID stored in ECX (0x143F-0x14EC)
     - Optional button string in [ESP+0x10]
  5. Display dialog based on button count (EDI):
     - 0: FUN_6fa77300 - single message dialog
     - 1: FUN_6fa76730 - title + message dialog
     - 2: FUN_6fa76980 - title + message + button dialog
  6. If bDisconnect (EBP), call Bnclient->Disconnect (vtable 0x10)
  7. Return 0 (FALSE - connection failed)

Parameters:
  pErrorInfo (ECX)  Pointer to BnetErrorInfo structure:
                    +0x00: dwErrorCode - Error type (1-22, see switch cases)
                    +0x04: pszErrorParam - Optional error string (case 6 only)

Returns:
  BOOL - Always returns FALSE (0) indicating connection failure

Error Code Reference:
  Code | Title ID | Message ID | Description
  1    | 0x147D   | 0x1443     | Connection timeout (2-button)
  2    | 0x147E   | 0x143F     | Unable to connect
  3    | 0x147F   | 0x1442     | Disconnected (2-button)
  4    | 0x147F   | 0x144F     | Server busy
  5    | 0x147F   | 0x1452     | Game version outdated
  6    | 0x147F   | 0x1450/51  | Custom error with param string
  7    | 0x147F   | 0x14EC     | Battle.net unavailable
  8    | 0x147F   | 0x1445     | Generic error (2-button)
  9    | 0x147C   | 0x1458     | CD Key in use (reconnect)
  10   | 0x147C   | 0x1457     | Invalid CD Key (reconnect)
  11   | 0x147C   | 0x1459     | CD Key banned (reconnect)
  12   | 0x1480   | 0x14E5     | Account closed
  13   | 0x1480   | 0x14EA     | Version check failed
  14   | 0x1480   | 0x14E3     | Account locked
  15   | 0x1481   | 0x146F     | Realm unavailable
  16   | 0x1481   | 0x1470     | Realm busy
  17   | 0x1481   | 0x1471     | Character timeout
  18   | 0x1481   | 0x1477     | Character locked
  19   | 0x1481   | 0x1472     | Character not found
  20   | 0x1481   | 0x1473     | Character deleted
  21   | 0x1481   | 0x1474     | Character expired
  22   | 0x1481   | 0x1475     | Character conversion

functions.signature: void CallFunctionOnRange(int nStartValue, int nStride, int nCount, pointer pfnCallback)
